market_base_token_supply.meaning: marketBaseTokenSupply, the market's current base token supply before the mint

no_cap_limit_shift.meaning: noCapLimit shift amount used in the small-market bound (1 << noCapLimit)

mint_operation_occurs.meaning: a user performs a mint operation in the small market

protocol_value_drained.meaning: value is drained from the protocol as a result of the mint

assumptions: The mint cap check is invoked during the mint operation in the small market.
The small-market bound is expressed as marketBaseTokenSupply <= (1 << noCapLimit) with noCapLimit a shift amount.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of the single-mint size limit relative to market total size, so the cap-enforcement relation cannot be expressed numerically; only the qualitative drain outcome is bound.
Report does not state whether the minting user is unauthorized or permissionless, so the access-control condition cannot include an authorization qualifier.

limitations: The cap-enforcement intent is represented only by the qualitative protocol-value-drain outcome; the numeric single-mint limit is not defined in the report.
The small-market bound is kept symbolic because noCapLimit and marketBaseTokenSupply have no concrete values.
Authorization of the minter is not established by the report and is not encoded.
